about: Renders a row of glyphs a person rates with. The arrow keys move the rating, Home and End set its bounds, and a pointer over an item previews its value.

field.about: A required rating in a field: the field's label names the group, and sending the form without a rating shows the error text. The hidden input stays empty until a person rates.
field.title: Required in a form

glyph.about: The glyph is the caller's. Three hearts in the accent palette, each named by `getItemLabel` in the page's words.
glyph.title: Another glyph

half.about: `allowHalf` with `readOnly` shows an average: the rated item fills its first half and is named "4.5 stars".
half.title: Halves, read only

hover.about: `onHoverChange` reports the value under the pointer, so the words follow the pointer and fall back to the rating when it leaves.
hover.title: Words that follow the pointer

palette.about: The palette the filled glyphs and the focus ring read. An invalid rating takes the error palette in place of any of them.
palette.title: Palettes

review.error: Choose a rating before you send the review.
review.label: Rate your stay

rtl.about: `dir="rtl"` mirrors the row: the first item is on the right, and a half item fills its right half.
rtl.title: Right to left

size.about: The glyphs are 16, 20 and 24px on the icon scale in items of at least 24px, from `sm` to `lg`.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: A disabled rating is dimmed and leaves the tab order. A read-only one keeps a tab stop on the rated item and refuses every change. An invalid one takes the error palette.
states.title: States

title: Rating group
